listing.name: Sin and Punishment — snprecomp (wootbeer)
listing.summary: The project describes native gameplay, translation and enhancements. Complete stage and campaign coverage are unknown; Linux gameplay is untested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese ROM with SHA-1 581297b9d5c3a4c33169ae0aae218c742cd9cbcf, or an English variant with SHA-1 5945ff3935d9d9531bbb5cfcabed7c198e2b2f41 or e3906c919236dac6eba020b4b8c1df91fd725c5d. This guide has not confirmed other translations; check the project’s requirements before using one.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s release instructions: extract SnPRecompiled.exe and choose your own supported ROM. A Linux tar.gz is published but untested. Source-build instructions are separate.

warnings: The project describes native gameplay, translation and enhancements. Complete stage and campaign coverage are unknown; Linux gameplay is untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
